headword: ショッピングセンター
reading: しょっぴんぐせんたー

definitions.explanation: A large retail complex housing many shops, restaurants, and often a supermarket under one roof, usually with a parking lot. Common in suburban areas.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}くにショッピングセンターができた。
examples.english: A shopping center has opened nearby.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{家族|かぞく}でショッピングセンターに{出|で}かける。
examples.english: On weekends we go to the shopping center as a family.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}のショッピングセンターには{映画館|えいがかん}も{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: The shopping center in front of the station also has a movie theater inside.

notes:
Loanword from English. In Japan, often abbreviated to SC (エスシー) in real estate and retail industry talk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大型|おおがた}ショッピングセンター: large shopping center
- ショッピングセンターに{行|い}く: to go to a shopping center
- {郊外|こうがい}{型|がた}ショッピングセンター: suburban-style shopping center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ショッピングモール: shopping mall — usually a larger, more enclosed complex
- {商店街|しょうてんがい}: shopping street — a row of independent stores along a street
- デパート: department store — single building owned by one retailer
